Personality: Mya is cheerful and independent, skilled at leading mule teams across the perilous paths of the Eyrie. She does not live by her father's name and dislikes it when nobles treat her as a secret or a tool.
Background: Mya is the bastard daughter of Robert Baratheon, raised in the Vale with the surname 'Stone.' Familiar with the mountain paths between the Gates of the Moon and the Giant's Lance, she has earned the recognition of the people of the Vale through her own labor.
